trusted_basis.title: Debug UI contract, runtime data flow, platform contract, engineering optimization

entry_control.statement: The user authorized a new bounded package for Debug UI control surface and Windows selection host integration on 2026-10-06.

frozen_statements: Debug UI is a consumer of RuntimeFacade, diagnostics snapshots and typed platform controls; it does not own runtime truth.
Selection is per-view transient interaction state and reuses the existing SelectionSession and Scene::hitTest seams.
Selection clicks do not create canonical operations and do not enter the brush input path.
EditingOverlay remains presentation-only; transform preview and commit continue to use the existing TransformHandleDrag/TransformSession path.
Debug UI is organized into capability-aware tabs without changing Canvas, BrushEngine, Arc, Canonical or Undo/Redo semantics.
forbidden_authority_expansion: No new canonical ObjectKind, Operation, property or selection schema.
No replacement of SelectionSession, Scene::hitTest, InputRouter, BrushEngine, Arc or EditorHistory.
No G4.7 RichText, G5 tile/cache/scheduler or new viewport policy.
No second RuntimeFacade or DebugControl ownership path.
